hierarchy_rules: The FCS is hierarchical: a permission at a general category applies to its subcategories unless otherwise stated.
Where a narrower subcategory contains a different entry for the same additive/group, PMSV applies the most specific applicable provision.
FCS descriptors are for additive assignment and are not legal product designations or labelling names.
Compound foods may receive additives pro rata through their components under the carry-over principle, unless a direct additive is needed for the compound food itself.

tables_scope.category_16_rule: Appendix A has no direct Table 16. Category 16 prepared foods are mixtures of components assigned to other categories and are assessed through component permissions/carry-over plus any specific applicable standard.

gmp_table.rule: Listed GMP additives may be used in all food categories except categories/items listed in the Annex to GMP, subject to Chapter 3.1(8) GMP.

category_16.name: Prepared foods
category_16.rule: Do not invent a direct additive permission for category 16. Resolve each component under its own FCS and apply Chapter 3.1 carry-over conditions; separately check any specific standard applicable to the prepared food.

group_resolution_policy.rule: Capitalised group entries used in the loaded Table 15 permission sets are expanded to the exact Annexure-1 members/INS numbers stored in annexure_1_groups. Unloaded groups from other tables remain locked until ingested.
group_resolution_policy.remaining_scope: Expand every remaining Annexure-1 group as Tables 1–14 are ingested.

note_resolution_policy.rule: The note numbers used by the loaded Table 15 permission sets are normalized in note_texts. Entries with any note outside this loaded set remain conditional until that note is added.

coverage.next_priority: Appendix A Tables 1–14 category-permission ingestion; add any additional Annexure-1 groups and note conditions encountered during each table.
